utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Good morning to you, Madam Registrar. Could you call the case, please?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is case number IT-05-88-T, the Prosecutor versus Vujadin Popovic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you, ma'am. For the record, all the accused are -- no. General Miletic is sick? Or what? No one advised me of that.

utterances.speaker: MS. FAUVEAU
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, General Miletic has a medical examination today and he waived his right to be presents during this hearing. He told me he agreed for the hearing to continue without him being present. You will receive his written authorisation during the course of the hearing today.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you, Madam Fauveau. From the Defence teams I notice the absence of Mr. Lazarevic. I think that's about it. But I also notice a new face -- amongst the Beara Defence team.

utterances.speaker: MR. MEEK
utterances.text: Mr. President, Your Honours, good morning, I'd like to introduce Mr. Milan Stanic, attorney at law from Belgrade.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Welcome, Mr. Stanic. I'm glad your name is much more simpler to pronounce than to pronounce than Janisiewicz.

utterances.speaker: MR. STANIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I would like to thank you for permitting me to attend today's hearing. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Stanic. Anyway, from the Prosecution side, we have Mr. McCloskey and Ms. Janisiewicz. By now it has become easy. Any preliminaries? None. Let's go into closed session, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 25th day of October, 2007, at 9.00 a.m. 22 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.46 p.m.,
